question: On p1, investigate the cached SHOPAPP SELECT that reads PRICE from PRODUCTS by PRODUCT_ID, last active between 1 Oct 2026 and 1 Jan 2027 UTC (start included, end excluded). If several statement IDs match, choose the lexicographically lowest. Use existing evidence without executing the statement; if absent, report a cache miss. Report each plan hash value and the number of cached child cursors using it. Does the cache demonstrate multiple plans? Do not infer a historical regression from one cached plan. Only consider cursors parsed by the SHOPAPP login (PARSING_USER_ID resolving to SHOPAPP), excluding diagnostic-account cursors even if their parsing schema is SHOPAPP.

groundTruth.sql: SELECT s.plan_hash_value AS plan_hash_value, COUNT(*) AS child_count FROM v$sql s WHERE s.parsing_user_id=(SELECT user_id FROM all_users WHERE username='SHOPAPP') AND s.sql_id=(SELECT s.sql_id FROM v$sql s WHERE s.parsing_schema_name='SHOPAPP' AND s.parsing_user_id=(SELECT user_id FROM all_users WHERE username='SHOPAPP') AND s.command_type=3 AND UPPER(s.sql_text) LIKE 'SELECT PRICE FROM PRODUCTS WHERE PRODUCT_ID%' AND FROM_TZ(CAST(s.last_active_time AS TIMESTAMP), '+00:00') >= TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ('2026-10-01 00:00:00 +00:00','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM') AND FROM_TZ(CAST(s.last_active_time AS TIMESTAMP), '+00:00') < TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ('2027-01-01 00:00:00 +00:00','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM') ORDER BY s.sql_id FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY) GROUP BY s.plan_hash_value ORDER BY s.plan_hash_value

statistics_presence FROM dba_tab_statistics t JOIN v$sql_plan p ON p.object_owner=t.owner AND p.object_name=t.table_name JOIN v$sql c ON c.sql_id=p.sql_id AND c.child_number=p.child_number AND c.parsing_user_id=(SELECT user_id FROM all_users WHERE username='SHOPAPP') WHERE p.sql_id=(SELECT s.sql_id FROM v$sql s WHERE s.parsing_schema_name='SHOPAPP' AND s.parsing_user_id=(SELECT user_id FROM all_users WHERE username='SHOPAPP') AND s.command_type=3 AND UPPER(s.sql_text) LIKE 'SELECT PRICE FROM PRODUCTS WHERE PRODUCT_ID%' AND FROM_TZ(CAST(s.last_active_time AS TIMESTAMP), '+00:00') >= TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ('2026-10-01 00:00:00 +00:00','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM') AND FROM_TZ(CAST(s.last_active_time AS TIMESTAMP), '+00:00') < TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ('2027-01-01 00:00:00 +00:00','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM') ORDER BY s.sql_id FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY) AND t.object_type='TABLE' UNION SELECT DISTINCT i.owner AS owner, i.index_name AS object_name, NVL(i.stale_stats,'UNKNOWN') AS stale_stats, CASE WHEN i.last_analyzed IS NULL THEN 'MISSING' ELSE 'PRESENT' END AS statistics_presence FROM dba_ind_statistics i JOIN v$sql_plan p ON p.object_owner=i.owner AND p.object_name=i.index_name JOIN v$sql c ON c.sql_id=p.sql_id AND c.child_number=p.child_number AND c.parsing_user_id=(SELECT user_id FROM all_users WHERE username='SHOPAPP') WHERE p.sql_id=(SELECT s.sql_id FROM v$sql s WHERE s.parsing_schema_name='SHOPAPP' AND s.parsing_user_id=(SELECT user_id FROM all_users WHERE username='SHOPAPP') AND s.command_type=3 AND UPPER(s.sql_text) LIKE 'SELECT PRICE FROM PRODUCTS WHERE PRODUCT_ID%' AND FROM_TZ(CAST(s.last_active_time AS TIMESTAMP), '+00:00') >= TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ('2026-10-01 00:00:00 +00:00','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM') AND FROM_TZ(CAST(s.last_active_time AS TIMESTAMP), '+00:00') < TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ('2027-01-01 00:00:00 +00:00','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM') ORDER BY s.sql_id FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY) AND i.object_type='INDEX' ORDER BY owner, object_name

If several statement IDs match, choose the lexicographically lowest. Use existing evidence without executing the statement; if absent, report a cache miss. Only consider cursors parsed by the SHOPAPP login (PARSING_USER_ID resolving to SHOPAPP), excluding diagnostic-account cursors even if their parsing schema is SHOPAPP.

groundTruth.sql: SELECT b.name AS bind_name, b.position AS position, b.datatype_string AS datatype, b.was_captured AS was_captured FROM v$sql_bind_capture b WHERE (b.sql_id,b.child_number) IN (SELECT s.sql_id,s.child_number FROM v$sql s WHERE s.parsing_user_id=(SELECT user_id FROM all_users WHERE username='SHOPAPP') AND s.sql_id=(SELECT s.sql_id FROM v$sql s WHERE s.parsing_schema_name='SHOPAPP' AND s.parsing_user_id=(SELECT user_id FROM all_users WHERE username='SHOPAPP') AND s.command_type=3 AND UPPER(s.sql_text) LIKE 'SELECT PRICE FROM PRODUCTS WHERE PRODUCT_ID%' AND FROM_TZ(CAST(s.last_active_time AS TIMESTAMP), '+00:00') >= TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ('2026-10-01 00:00:00 +00:00','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM') AND FROM_TZ(CAST(s.last_active_time AS TIMESTAMP), '+00:00') < TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ('2027-01-01 00:00:00 +00:00','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZH:TZM') ORDER BY s.sql_id FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY) ORDER BY s.child_number FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY) ORDER BY b.position
